name: Notta
tagline: AI transcription and meeting notes for Zoom, Teams, Google Meet and Webex, plus file uploads and mobile recording.
bestFor: Individuals who need cheap multilingual transcription
description: Notta records and transcribes online meetings, uploaded files and in-person audio, then writes AI summaries. A free plan includes 120 minutes per month, and Pro costs $8.17 per month billed annually ($97.99 per year).
pros: Pro is $97.99 per year for 1,800 transcription minutes per month
Business includes unlimited transcription minutes, capped at 5 hours per recording
Business adds CRM sync with Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho CRM and others
Apps for web, iOS, Android, Mac, Windows and a Chrome extension
cons: Free plan caps each recording at 3 minutes and allows 10 AI summaries per month
SAML SSO is Enterprise only, and Enterprise starts at 51 seats
Real-time translation and bilingual transcription are paid add-ons ($10 and $15 per month)
freePlanDetails: Free: 1 seat, 120 transcription minutes per month, 3 minutes max per recording, 50 file uploads and 10 AI summaries per month. No credit card required.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 120 minutes/month, 3-minute max per recording, 10 AI summaries/month.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 1 seat. $97.99 billed annually. 1,800 minutes/month, 5 hours per recording, 100 file uploads and 100 AI summaries/month. Monthly-billing price was not shown in the pricing page text. 50% education discount.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Per seat; $199.99 per seat billed annually. Unlimited minutes (5 hours per recording), 200 file uploads and 200 AI summaries/month, CRM and Zapier integrations. Monthly-billing price was not shown in the pricing page text.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: From 51 seats. Adds SAML SSO, unlimited uploads and summaries, priority support.

integrations: Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Webex; Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho CRM, Zendesk Sell, Salesflare, Freshsales; Zapier

name: Sembly
tagline: AI meeting notetaker for professional services that turns client calls into notes, tasks and deliverables.
bestFor: Agencies and consultancies producing client deliverables from meetings
description: Sembly records Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams and Webex calls, writes notes and uses monthly Studio credits to generate client deliverables. Basic costs $14 per user per month, or $10 billed annually.
pros: Every paid plan includes unlimited meeting hours
Native automations push meeting notes to HubSpot and Salesforce
Supports 45+ languages on all plans
HIPAA compliance and custom SSO are available on MAX ($30 per user per month annually)
cons: Free plan is limited to 5 meeting hours in total and 1 month of history
Basic allows only 1 integration and 1 automation per user
MAX needs at least 3 users and Enterprise at least 10
freePlanDetails: Free: 1 user, 5 meeting hours in total, 1 month of meeting history and video retention, a one-time bonus of Studio credits (the page lists both 1,500 and 2,500).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 5 meeting hours total, 1 user.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: 1 user. Unlimited meeting hours, 12 months history, 1 integration and 1 automation per user. Monthly Studio credits listed inconsistently on the page (1,500 or 2,500).

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Per user, up to 40 users. Unlimited meeting hours, 24 months history, 5 integrations and 5 automations per user. Studio credits listed as 2,500 or 3,000 per month.

plans.name: MAX
plans.notes: Per user, 3 to 500 users. 3,500 Studio credits per user per month, unlimited history, HIPAA compliance, custom SSO, audit log.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Minimum 10 users; unlimited users, clients and brand packages; HIPAA and custom SSO.

integrations: Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Webex; HubSpot and Salesforce automations; Zapier, webhooks, MCP

name: Supernormal
tagline: Bot-free desktop notetaker that turns meetings into notes, documents, slides and other client work.
bestFor: Agencies that want meeting notes without a bot joining calls
description: Supernormal's Mac and Windows desktop app captures Zoom, Google Meet, Teams and Slack Huddle calls without a bot, then uses AI credits to write notes and documents. A free plan includes 15 credits per month, and Team costs $20 per month for 50 shared credits.
pros: Desktop app captures meetings without a bot joining the call
Paid plans include unlimited seats that share one credit pool
Signs a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement on request
Unused credits roll over on annual plans
cons: Bot notetaker, Chrome extension, and video and audio recording were retired in 2026
Mac app requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14.4.1 or later; Windows app is in beta
Credit cost per meeting or task is not published
freePlanDetails: Free: 15 credits per month, maximum 5 credits used per day, desktop app meeting capture, unlimited projects, MCP. No credit card required.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 15 credits/month, 5 credits/day max.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Flat per workspace (not per seat): 50 credits/month shared by unlimited seats, no daily credit limit, credit rollover. Annual price not published (pricing page showed $0 placeholders).

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Flat per workspace (not per seat): 50 credits/month shared by unlimited seats, plus SSO, audit logs, data retention and admin controls. Annual price not published.

integrations: Google Calendar, Outlook Calendar, Slack, Gmail, Linear, Google Drive; MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor

name: Grain
tagline: AI meeting recorder and notetaker for sales and customer teams, with CRM autofill and coaching.
bestFor: Sales teams that want notes and fields synced to HubSpot or Salesforce
description: Grain records Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams and Webex calls, or captures them without a bot through its desktop app, and writes AI notes. A free plan is available, and Pro costs $19 per month or $15 per month billed yearly.
pros: Business syncs notes and autofills CRM fields in HubSpot and Salesforce
Free Lite seats can view shared meetings and AI notes without a paid license
Desktop Capture on Mac and Windows records transcripts and notes without a bot
SOC 2 Type II certified
cons: Pro is for a single user; team workspaces need Business at $29-$39 per seat
Business requires a minimum of 2 paid seats
SAML SSO and SCIM are Enterprise only
freePlanDetails: Free for one person. The pricing page lists 20 meetings; Grain's help center says unlimited meetings up to 45 minutes each, 30-day history and 5 manual uploads.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Single user; meetings up to 45 minutes each, 30-day history (pricing page also lists a 20-meeting limit).

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Single-user plan; unlimited meetings up to 4 hours each, full history, custom AI prompts and note templates.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Per Full seat, minimum 2 Full seats; Lite (viewer) seats free. Meetings up to 8 hours, HubSpot, Salesforce, Slack and Aircall integrations with CRM field autofill, AI coaching.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Adds SAML SSO, SCIM, audit logs, 1080p recording, bring-your-own LLM.

integrations: Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Webex, Slack huddles; HubSpot, Salesforce, Slack, Aircall

tagline: Bot-free AI notetaker that records, transcribes and summarizes online and in-person meetings.
bestFor: Teams that want meeting notes without a bot in the call
description: Bluedot records Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams calls through a Chrome extension and desktop and mobile apps without sending a bot, then writes AI notes. Basic costs $18 per user per month, or $14 billed annually.
pros: Unlimited meetings and storage on every paid plan
Business syncs notes, transcripts and action items to HubSpot and Salesforce
SSO, SAML and SCIM supported on Business

cons: Free plan is limited to 5 meetings in total
Basic records audio only and caps recordings at 1 hour
No HIPAA or BAA is mentioned on the pricing or security pages
